options.content:
**Purpose:** an administrator-managed gateway from Grafana to an AI provider. The backend holds provider credentials and enforces model, token, timeout, and request limits. It returns an answer as a DataFrame or as a resource response to the companion panel.

**Default mode: MOCK — no AI inference.** The table below is a fixed connection receipt, not a data assessment.

**Wider use:** summarize selected query results for incident triage, traffic comparison, or operator handover. The companion panel assembles Grafana DataFrames and instructions; the data source sends them to the configured model. It does not fetch metrics from other data sources by itself.

[See the complete traffic-shift walkthrough and real-provider setup](https://github.com/digitalrcs/grafana-intelligence-gateway/wiki/Reviewer-Walkthrough).
